## Place the submitted folder {#pick-folder auto-animate="true"}

```{=html}
<div class="sa-scene sa-grid">
  <div class="sa-panel"><p class="sa-panel-title">Incoming</p>
    <span class="sa-chip sa-literal" data-id="moving-folder">devices/</span>
  </div>
  <div class="sa-panel sa-dropzone" data-id="materials-box" data-sa-qa-fixed="materials-box">
    <p class="sa-panel-title">materials/</p><div class="sa-tree"><div class="sa-row">fundamentals/</div></div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Place the submitted folder {#drop-folder auto-animate="true"}

```{=html}
<div class="sa-scene sa-grid">
  <div class="sa-panel"><p class="sa-panel-title">Incoming</p></div>
  <div class="sa-panel sa-dropzone" data-id="materials-box" data-sa-qa-fixed="materials-box">
    <p class="sa-panel-title">materials/</p><div class="sa-tree"><div class="sa-row">fundamentals/</div>
    <div class="sa-row"><span class="sa-chip sa-literal" data-id="moving-folder">devices/</span></div></div>
  </div>
</div>
```
